render.answerNotApproving: the answer was {{answer}}, which doesn't approve it{{on}}

store.idInMultipleProjects: {{id}} exists in more than one project ({{where}}) — use the lettered form, e.g. {{example}}
store.authorRequired: --author is required: every entry says who wrote it
store.questionsAndOptionsMixed: sub-questions and plain options can't be mixed: with --question, the node's own options are generated automatically
store.taskOrFyiNoQuestions: a task or fyi has no questions
store.taskNoOptions: a task has no options — use nod ask later if it needs a decision
store.parentTreeArchived: {{ref}}'s tree is already archived; first nod archive {{id}} --undo
store.fyiIsRoot: an fyi is a root node; it has no parent
store.bodyHasQuestionsSection: body already has a ## 子问题 section — drop it, --question writes it
store.questionsBlockMismatch: the 子问题 block did not read back as written — a label probably contains a heading marker
store.bodyOptionsMismatch: body already has an options heading, but it does not match -o: {{diff}} — drop the heading from --body/stdin, or make it match -o exactly
store.answerNeedsChoiceOrNote: an answer needs a choice or a note
store.subQuestionOtherNeedsText: {{key}}'s "other" needs the text you typed — e.g. {{key}}=*:your answer
store.approvalContentNoUrl: --approval-content's target must be a local file, not a URL
store.approveOnAmbiguous: {{ref}} has {{what}} — which answer counts as approval? Add --approve-on, e.g. --approve-on {{example}}
store.cantStartNeedsDecision: {{ref}} is still waiting on the owner's decision, can't start (add --force if you really mean to)
store.cantStartOpenOptions: {{ref}} still has options waiting on the owner, so it stays waiting for a decision and can’t start — not even with --force. Once they answer it can start; to change the question, use nod ask.
store.cantStartAfter: {{ref}} is after {{after}}, which aren't finished yet (add --force if you really mean to)
store.holdNeedsOn: waiting on who, on what? e.g. --on "Bob to send evidence"
store.holdNotForOwner: {{ref}} is waiting on the owner's decision — that's not waiting on something external
store.alreadyFinishedNoDefer: {{ref}} is already finished, no need to defer it
store.closeNeedsReason: closing needs a reason: superseded | obsolete | merged-into:<ref> | free text
store.multipleOptionsBlocks: the text has more than one ## 选项 block — keep one
store.askTextOptionsMismatch: the text's ## 选项 block does not match -o: {{diff}} — drop the block, or make it match -o exactly
store.askNoOptions: this node has no options left to ask about: nod ask needs -o 1="…" 2="…"
store.optionsDidNotRoundTrip: {{ref}}: the new options did not read back as written — check the body by hand
store.progressOnFinished: {{ref}} is already {{state}}, progress shouldn't change anymore
store.parentInOwnSubtree: {{parent}} is inside {{ref}}'s own subtree, can't hang it underneath
store.letterAmbiguous: letter {{letter}} belongs to both {{projects}} — use a project name instead, e.g. {{example}}
store.optionKeysMustBeDigits: option keys must be 1-9, got {{keys}} — pass -o 1="…" 2="…"
store.defaultNotAnOption: --default {{default}} is not one of the options ({{keys}})
store.notATime: "{{since}}" is not a time — use ISO, e.g. 2026-10-28T10:00:00+08:00
store.briefIsTask: a brief is a task: no options, no --fyi
store.claimFinished: {{ref}} is {{state}} — nothing left to pick up
store.alreadyClaimed: {{ref}} was already picked up by {{by}} at {{at}} — leave it to them (--force takes it over)
store.milestoneNeedsDue: {{ref}}: a milestone needs a date — add --due 2026-11-15 (or 3d)
store.attachToOutOfRange: --to {{n}} is out of range for this node (notes: {{count}})
store.humanTaskNoClaim: {{ref}} is the owner's own to-do, not a brief for an AI
store.editStale: {{ref}} changed since you opened it — reload and edit again
store.notYourNote: {{ref}}: note {{n}} was written by someone else — --force to edit it anyway
store.answerIsRecord: {{ref}}: note {{n}} is an answer — each answer stays as it was written. To change it, answer again: the new answer is added below the old one.
store.noEvery: {{ref}} has no R — set one with nod edit {{ref}} --every 3d
store.alreadyFinishedNoHand: {{ref}} is already finished; nothing to hand over
store.waitOnTooLong: --on is who or what it waits on, in a few words — this is {{cols}} columns, the limit is {{max}}. Put the details in a note: nod note {{id}} "…"
store.summaryNeeded: this reply needs a one-line summary: --summary "…" (≤60 CJK characters / ≤120 Latin ones)
store.summaryTooLong: the summary itself is over the limit: ≤60 CJK characters / ≤120 Latin ones
store.summaryBadChars: a summary can't contain a line break or "-->" — keep it to one plain line

title.tooLong:
title too long: {{width}} columns, limit {{max}} (~{{half}} CJK characters). The title should only name what to decide; details go in the body.
  "{{title}}"

ref.notANodeNumber: "{{raw}}" is not a node number — write 305, W305 or web:305
ref.nameAndLetter: "{{raw}}" gives both a project name and a project letter — keep only one

project.badLetter: the project letter must be one capital letter A–Z, got "{{letter}}"

questions.badKey: sub-question key "{{key}}" must look like Q1, R2: one capital letter and a number
questions.noDefault: sub-question {{key}} has no default: --default {{key}}:{{option}} — "all defaults" needs to know what to pick
questions.defaultNotAnOption: {{key}}'s default {{default}} is not one of its options ({{keys}})

steps.noneYet: there are no steps yet — set them first with nod steps <id> "a" "b" …

upgrade.bothFormsExist:
the same number exists under both filename styles — merge them by hand, then run again:
{{lines}}
upgrade.dropStaleDefault: drop stale default "{{default}}" (finished, no options to point at)
upgrade.optionsNotRecognised: options not recognised — fix by hand with nod ask (default "{{default}}")

sources.badName: source name "{{name}}" is not valid — only letters/digits/._- , and it can't start with a symbol
sources.badDuration: "{{value}}" is not a valid duration, use a format like 30s / 15m / 2h / 1d
sources.notRegistered: source "{{name}}" is not registered yet — first `nod source register {{name}} --title "..."`
sources.notAJsonObject: line {{line}} is not a JSON object

migrate.optionsNotExtracted: options: could not confidently extract (found {{count}} candidate(s))
migrate.emptyTitleHeading: empty title in heading, used fallback
migrate.noAuthorHeading: no author found (neither heading parentheses nor a "提出者" line)
migrate.nestedHeadingMismatch: nested heading D{{nestedId}} does not match outer D{{outerId}}; kept outer id
migrate.noExtractableAnswer: archived entry has no extractable answer/resolution text; marked answered with an empty note
migrate.otherNestedHeadings: block also contains {{count}} other nested heading(s) ({{ids}}) that were not split out — kept as body text under D{{outerId}}
migrate.legacyIdReused: legacy id D{{from}} was already used by another entry in this corpus; renumbered to D{{to}}

views.badFilter: Can't read the filter term "{{term}}" — write field:value, e.g. state:waiting
views.badField: "{{field}}" is not a filter field; one of: {{fields}}
views.badIs: is:{{value}} is not something a node can be; one of: {{values}}
views.notAnObject: A view definition is a JSON object
views.badId: "{{id}}" can't be a view id: lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 32
views.lastOne: The bench needs at least one view
views.notBuiltin: {{id}} is not a built-in view ({{ids}}); nod view rm removes your own
